Vendored MoQ (Media over QUIC) browser client for our rooms (src/rooms/moq.ts, public/assets/room.js).

watch.js    @moq/watch 0.6.6    (viewers: subscribe, WebCodecs decode, A/V sync, canvas + audio worklet)
publish.js  @moq/publish 0.5.4  (host: WebCodecs encode, catalog, publish)
chunk-*.js  shared code split out by the bundler

Bundled packages and their licences (exact versions):
  @moq/watch 0.6.6, @moq/publish 0.5.4, @moq/hang 0.5.4, @moq/net 0.4.7, @moq/qmux 0.3.4, @moq/json 0.4.3,
  @moq/msf 0.3.1, @moq/loc 0.2.4, @moq/signals 0.2.6, @moq/pattern 0.2.1, @moq/flate 0.1.4,
  @moq/web-socket-stream 0.1.1                         MIT OR Apache-2.0 (used here under MIT), https://github.com/moq-dev/moq
  zod 4.6.7, async-mutex 0.5.0, bowser 2.15.0, media-captions 0.0.18   MIT
  pako 3.0.3                                           MIT AND Zlib
  @svta/cml-utils 1.7.0, @svta/cml-iso-bmff 1.0.7      Apache-2.0

Not bundled: the optional libav.js Opus polyfill (@libav.js/variant-opus-af, LGPL-2.1) that @moq/hang loads only
in browsers without native WebCodecs Opus. Those browsers fall back to the SFU instead.

How it was built (reproducible):
  npm install --save-exact --ignore-scripts @moq/publish@0.5.4 @moq/watch@0.6.6
  watch.js   = export * as Watch from '@moq/watch'; export { isSupported } from '@moq/watch/support';
  publish.js = export * as Publish from '@moq/publish';
  esbuild watch.js publish.js --bundle --format=esm --splitting --minify --target=es2022 --outdir=out \
    --entry-names=[name] --chunk-names=chunk-[hash] --legal-comments=none \
    --external:@libav.js/variant-opus-af --external:@kixelated/libavjs-webcodecs-polyfill
